title: Utility Line Protection Plans Claims Authorization Standard: Repairs, Replacements and Allowances
content:
# Claims Authorization Standard: Repairs, Replacements and Allowances

Claims desk standard for authorizing work on covered occurrences under the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans. Clauses marked as no longer in force are kept here as they were issued, with the extent of their retirement stated beside them.

## Clauses

**A1.** Line work is authorized only after a covered determination is on file for the service request.

**A2.** Each occurrence is paid up to the plan's occurrence cap for the line type, counted by the benefit paid on the occurrence, and occurrences are not limited in number.
> **Partly no longer in force.** For permanent work on an interior supply or drain line, and for permanent work on an exterior line, whose contractor quote is above the payment Bridgewell makes toward that work, the amounts the current basis for that work pays on top of the occurrence cap are no longer limited by this clause, and only for such work. Every other payment on an occurrence remains within the occurrence cap under clause A2.

**A3.** The contractor repairs the failed section, except that the whole line from the connection point to the home is replaced when the plan's full-replacement break count is above 0 and the prior breaks in the lookback are at or above the full-replacement break count minus 1.

**A4.** Trenchless methods are used only when the plan allows the trenchless method and cost no more than open trenching.

**A5.** When the plan covers emergency temporary repair, a temporary repair to restore service is authorized first and counts toward the same occurrence.

**A6.** Restoration allowances are paid inside the occurrence cap, never in addition to it: the public way restoration allowance for a public sidewalk, curb or street, the landscaping restoration allowance for basic lawn restoration, the slab access allowance for access through a slab, and permits, camera inspection and cleanout installation where the plan pays permits, camera inspection and cleanout installation.
> **Partly no longer in force.** For access through a slab, for a public sidewalk, curb or street, and for basic lawn restoration, the bare allowance named in this clause is no longer in force: each is paid at the payment worked out under its current basis, still inside the occurrence cap, and only for such access or restoration. The clause is likewise no longer in force for the acceptance camera inspection of a sewer lateral replaced whole, which is paid on top of the occurrence cap under its current basis, and only for that inspection. Every other restoration allowance remains under clause A6, as do permits, cleanout installation and every other camera inspection, which is paid inside the occurrence cap.

**A7.** Private driveways and patios are restored only when the plan restores hardscape.

**A8.** Each authorization pays the lower of its invoice amount and the remaining occurrence benefit; the customer may pay the contractor for work beyond the cap or decline it.
> **Partly no longer in force.** This clause is no longer in force for a slab access allowance, a public way restoration allowance or a landscaping restoration allowance, nor for permanent work on an interior supply or drain line or on an exterior line whose contractor quote is above the payment Bridgewell makes toward that work; the amount paid on each of those is set by its current basis, and only for it. Every other authorization remains under clause A8 and pays the lower of its invoice amount and the remaining occurrence benefit.

**A9.** A recall is paid under the original occurrence and its remaining benefit.

**A10.** An authorization is reversed in full when the work will not be performed and never after completion.

**A11.** The completion report starts the repair guarantee.

## Terms used

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Occurrence | a new-failure service request together with any recall request that names it through its repaired section |
| Benefit paid on the occurrence | the sum of repair authorization amounts on the occurrence, allowances included, less the amounts of reversals of those authorizations |
| Remaining occurrence benefit | the occurrence cap for the line less the benefit paid on the occurrence |
| Prior breaks in the lookback | the count of earlier covered new-failure occurrences on the same line type of the same property, across this and any earlier plan held for the address, with a completed section repair in the plan's replacement lookback period of calendar days ending on the request date |

## Occurrence cap by line

| Line named on the request | Occurrence cap used |
|---|---|
| exterior water service line | the water line occurrence cap |
| sewer lateral | the sewer line occurrence cap |
| septic line | the sewer line occurrence cap |
| exterior electrical service line | the electrical line occurrence cap |
| interior supply line | the interior plumbing occurrence cap |
| interior drain line | the interior plumbing occurrence cap |
| exterior gas service line | the gas line occurrence cap |

## Whole-line replacement (clause A3) in cases

| Full-replacement break count | Prior breaks in the lookback | Work |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | any number | the failed section is repaired |
| 2 | 0 | the failed section is repaired |
| 2 | 1 | the whole line is replaced |
| 2 | 3 | the whole line is replaced |

## Clause A8 for an authorization still under it (hypothetical figures)

An item invoiced at $900.00 with $600.00 of occurrence benefit remaining pays $600.00; the customer may pay the contractor the other $300.00 or decline that work. An item invoiced at $400.00 with $600.00 remaining pays $400.00.
